format_divergence.reason_en: Same reasoning as checkpoints 1 and 2. Three checkpoints now diverge the same way; if the engine enforces the Part F mix this needs settling before checkpoint 4.

questions.question_en: Listen again. What has the announcement told them?
options: The train is two hours late and has not started out
questions.explanation_en: दो घंटे, and अभी तक चली भी नहीं — it has not even left its origin.

questions.question_en: Across the dhaba dialogues, which of these is true?
options: The kadhi needs ten minutes and the pickle is free
Everything is ready and nothing is free
The kadhi is ready and the pickle costs extra
questions.explanation_en: दस मिनट में बन जाएगी for the kadhi, and अचार तो फ़्री है for the pickle.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Three people are talking. Who decides what the third friend eats?
options: The first friend orders for him
The second friend orders for him
questions.explanation_en: मेरे लिए कुछ भी। तुम ऑर्डर कर दो — he hands it to the friend who is already talking to the waiter.

questions.question_en: भिजवा दीजिए, बनवा दीजिए, बिना प्याज़ का, वेज है ना — what are these speakers all doing?
options: Asking for something to be changed or checked, politely
questions.explanation_en: Causatives ask for an outcome without instructing the person in front of you, and the ना and क्या tags check without interrogating.

questions.question_en: The waiter says लोगों को बहुत पसंद आते हैं. How does पसंद आना differ from पसंद है?
options: पसंद आना is only used about food
पसंद आना is a reaction to something; पसंद है is a standing preference
questions.explanation_en: पसंद है is what you always order; पसंद आया is what you thought of tonight's.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: प्लेटफ़ॉर्म तीन ___ ।
questions.explanation_en: पर for a platform, a floor, or any point you arrive at.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: दो ___ का रिज़र्वेशन है।
questions.explanation_en: का is a postposition like any other, so the plural goes oblique.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: ब्लू लाइन ___ जाइए।
questions.explanation_en: से for the route you travel by.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: येलो लाइन ___ है।
questions.explanation_en: लाइन is feminine, so the infinitive in an obligation takes -नी.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: ___ जेब में रखा था, पक्का।
questions.explanation_en: रखना is transitive and the tense is perfective, so ने.
